sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the non-applicable false branch, distinct fixed and azimuthing applicability, all declared operand paths, canonical owners, datatypes, units, the ship-to-designCondition relationship, normal-operational applicability, expected-load equality, and the DIRECT_CHECK capacity >= local ice pressure violation test.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not require designConditionExpectedLoad as an unused mandatory value, and do not leave the expected-load relationship as presence-only. Either remove that undeclared obligation or encode, with the existing canonical terms, the required relationship that the applicable azimuthing thruster-body ice-interaction load is the expected service-life load under normal operational conditions. Preserve the declared ship-to-designCondition path, both applicability alternatives, units, and the capacity >= localIcePressure DIRECT_CHECK.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unapproved external/generated IRI(s): http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#
Semantic validator feedback: Repair the SPARQL constraint: use the registered QUDT namespace http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/ (not http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#), and make the query select violations rather than compliant cases. For azimuthing thrusters, require the existing hasDesignCondition path with normalOperationalConditions=true and require designConditionExpectedLoad to match thrusterBodyIceInteractionLoad; the current first EXISTS rejects equality and the OR branches create accidental passes. Preserve both azimuthing and fixed applicability alternatives, all supplied operand paths and units, and the DIRECT_CHECK designConditionLocalStrengthCapacity >= localIcePressure (report a violation only when capacity < pressure).

Repair the applicability alternatives. A ship with mainPropulsionThruster=false must satisfy the non-applicable branch without requiring thrusterType; requiring thrusterType there creates an accidental failure and incorrectly constrains ships outside the stated scope. Preserve separate mainPropulsionThruster=true branches for thrusterType="fixed" and thrusterType="azimuthing", with the supplied load requirements, hasDesignCondition path, normalOperationalConditions=true, expected-load equality, and capacity >= localIcePressure violation check. Preserve all supplied owners, datatypes, units, and canonical namespace.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the non-applicable false branch, distinct fixed and azimuthing applicability, all declared operand paths, canonical owners, datatypes, units, the ship-to-designCondition relationship, normal-operational applicability, expected-load equality, and the DIRECT_CHECK capacity >= local ice pressure violation test.
